description: Contains drafts and notes for an essay or book on the town, culture, and people of Abiquiu, three page story probably set in Abiquiu; poems; ideas for stories and characters; lists of words and expressions in Spanish and in English, quotations from conversations; a typed transcript, noted in a letter from Merriam Golden, Mar, 1941; notes on the trial of Felipe Martinez, 1934.
title: Abiquiu
